articles.title: Singapore's top university destroys tumors with magnetic pulses, no chemo needed
articles.content: Researchers at the National University of Singapore have used brief pulses of a weak magnetic field to eliminate breast tumors in 75% of the mice they tested, without any chemotherapy.

articles.title: Chinese nationals face 40 years over kidnapping of Singaporean at Malaysia airport
articles.content: They face one count under Section 3(1) of the Kidnapping Act 1961, read with Section 34 of the Penal Code, which covers acts carried out with common intention. Conviction carries 30 to 40 years in prison and caning.

articles.title: Humans must become wiser to coexist with AI 'species'
articles.content: Last June, I taught a class on AI at a summer camp for 60 students aged 12 to 20.

articles.title: Tech workers spiral into anxiety, exhaustion because of 'age 35 curse'
articles.content: Shutting his laptop at 3:00 a.m. with vision blurred after a grueling 16-hour shift, 27-year-old The Vinh found sleep impossible, his limbs trembling with fatigue.

articles.title: US colleges are so short of students they're admitting people who never applied
articles.content: Hundreds of U.S. colleges are admitting high school students who never applied, as the number of American 18-year-olds begins a long decline.

articles.title: Passengers wait for 6 hours to collect baggage at Thailand's largest airport amid heavy flooding
articles.content: Passengers arriving at Bangkok's Suvarnabhumi Airport had to wait up to six hours for their bags, while luggage from several flights was left behind amid disruptions to Thai Airways's ground operations.

articles.title: Japanese retail giant Aeon targets 300 supermarkets, 30 shopping malls in Vietnam
articles.content: Japan's retail giant Aeon is stepping up its expansion in Vietnam, with plans to eventually operate 300 supermarkets and 30 shopping malls across the Southeast Asian country.

articles.title: Ronaldo leaves Portugal training camp after coach drops him from upcoming match
articles.content: Portugal captain and striker Cristiano Ronaldo said Wednesday he had walked out on the national team's training camp in Copenhagen after coach Jorge Jesus announced the 41-year-old player would be dropped from the team's next match against Denmark.
